journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

articles.title_en: The Term Structure of Monetary Policy Uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 货币政策不确定性的期限结构
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the transmission of Federal Reserve communication to financial markets and the economy using new measures of the term structure of policy rate uncertainty. High-frequency movements in the term structure of interest rate uncertainty around FOMC announcements cannot be summarized by a single measure but, instead, are two dimensional. We characterize these two dimensions as the Level and Slope factors of the term structure of interest rate uncertainty. These two monetary policy uncertainty factors help to explain changes in Treasury yields and forward real interest rates following FOMC announcements, even after accounting for changes in the expected path of policy rates. Finally, compared to high-frequency instruments derived from interest rate futures, our policy uncertainty factors provide stronger first-stage instruments and imply FOMC forward guidance has been more effective in stimulating economic activity in a standard proxy SVAR.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用政策利率不确定性期限结构的新度量，研究了美联储沟通向金融市场和经济的传导。围绕FOMC公告的利率不确定性期限结构的高频变动不能由单一度量概括，而是二维的。我们将这两个维度刻画为利率不确定性期限结构的水平因子和斜率因子。这两个货币政策不确定性因子有助于解释FOMC公告后美国国债收益率和远期实际利率的变化，即使在考虑了政策利率预期路径的变化之后也是如此。最后，与从利率期货中推导出的高频工具相比，我们的政策不确定性因子提供了更强的第一阶段工具，并表明在标准代理SVAR中，FOMC的前瞻性指引在刺激经济活动方面更为有效。

articles.title_en: The transitional impact of state pension reform
articles.title_cn: 国家养老金改革的过渡影响
articles.abstract_en: We use an overlapping generations framework to evaluate the transitional impact of state pension reform on public and private workers, extending our analysis to all fifty U.S. states. We consider reducing cost-of-living-adjustments (COLAs) for retirees and reducing benefit accruals for current workers. The magnitude of reform in each state is calibrated to achieve a common policy goal: the elimination of unfunded pension liabilities within twenty years.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用世代交叠框架评估国家养老金改革对公共和私人部门工人的过渡影响，并将分析扩展到美国所有五十个州。我们考虑减少退休人员的生活成本调整（COLA）以及减少当前工人的福利累积。各州改革的力度经过校准，以实现一个共同的政策目标：在二十年内消除无资金准备的养老金负债。

articles.title_en: The redistributive effects of size-dependent childcare policies
articles.title_cn: 规模依赖型儿童保育政策的再分配效应
articles.abstract_en: Governments often adopt policies to reduce the cost of childcare for working families, but those can distort the allocation of resources. We develop and calibrate a general equilibrium model with firm and household heterogeneity and study the case of Chile, where firms with more than 19 female employees must provide childcare. We find that removing this policy would increase welfare on average by 2.3% of consumption equivalent units over their lifetime. However, the removal would not translate into increases in GDP, in part because of a reduced labor supply. Instead, the main effects of the policy are redistributive, shifting resources away from females towards males. The policy reduces welfare for most females, and these losses are decreasing in income. In particular, low-education single females, who do not rely on a second wage, would gain up to 20% in consumption equivalent units by removing the policy. We propose that alternative childcare financing options would be preferred. Specifically, financing childcare through labor taxes would increase aggregate welfare by over 13%, with the largest gains accruing to single, low-education mothers.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府经常采取政策来降低工薪家庭儿童保育的成本，但这些政策可能会扭曲资源配置。我们构建并校准了一个包含企业和家庭异质性的一般均衡模型，并以智利为案例进行研究，该国规定拥有超过19名女性员工的企业必须提供儿童保育。我们发现，取消这一政策将使福利平均增加2.3%的终身消费等价单位。然而，取消该政策并不会转化为GDP的增长，部分原因是劳动供给减少。相反，该政策的主要影响是再分配性的，将资源从女性转向男性。该政策降低了大多数女性的福利，且这些损失随收入增加而减少。特别是，不依赖第二份工资的低教育单身女性，取消该政策将使其消费等价单位增加高达20%。我们提出，替代性的儿童保育融资方式将更受青睐。具体而言，通过劳动税为儿童保育融资将使总体福利增加超过13%，其中最大的收益归于单身、低教育水平的母亲。

articles.title_en: Counterparty choice, maturity shifts and market freezes: Lessons from the European interbank market
articles.title_cn: 对手方选择、期限转移与市场冻结：来自欧洲银行间市场的教训
articles.abstract_en: We explore the impact of relationship lending on the interbank debt maturity structure of banks using data from the e-MID market covering both pre- and post-Lehman periods. We study the term structure and maturity shortening of interbank lending as an indicator of risk in times of stress. We identify bank-level and pair-level variables which are shown to contain information about the behaviour of lending relations during times of stress. Using a two-part fractional response model we show that durable liquidity relationships increase the probability of contracting term loans, but do not prevent maturity shortening during periods of acute stress. Finally, we find that lenders with concentrated short-term interbank liability structure tend to reduce their own long term lending, which confirms the rollover risk viewpoint of term interbank market freeze. Our findings are relevant for the modelling of interbank networks under stress and the design of forward looking stress tests for the banking system.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用覆盖雷曼事件前后时期的e-MID市场数据，探讨关系型贷款对银行间债务期限结构的影响。我们研究银行间贷款的期限结构和期限缩短，作为压力时期风险的指标。我们识别出银行层面和配对层面的变量，这些变量被证明包含压力时期贷款关系行为的信息。使用两部分分数响应模型，我们表明持久流动性关系增加了签订定期贷款的概率，但在严重压力时期并不能防止期限缩短。最后，我们发现短期银行间负债结构集中的贷款人倾向于减少自身的长期贷款，这证实了银行间定期市场冻结的展期风险观点。我们的发现对于压力下银行间网络的建模以及银行系统前瞻性压力测试的设计具有相关性。

articles.title_en: Fiscal policy with an informal sector
articles.title_cn: 包含非正规部门的财政政策
articles.abstract_en: On the eve of its sovereign debt crisis in 2010, Greece initiated a large fiscal consolidation program. By 2015, official GDP had fallen to 26% below its 2009 level. We feed the actual fiscal package in the DSGE model of the Bank of Greece, augmented to include an informal sector, to assess the contribution of the fiscal package as well as of its individual tax and spending components. The model explains the bulk of the cumulative reduction in economic activity, and attributes roughly half of the decline to government spending measures and the other half to tax increases. The interaction of a large fiscal adjustment with a large and elastic informal sector proved lethal. Our model predicts that had growth in shadow activities been contained, the vicious circle between fiscal adjustment, tax revenue and macroeconomic activity could have been significantly mitigated, resulting in a considerably milder downturn.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2010年主权债务危机前夕，希腊启动了一项大规模的财政整顿计划。到2015年，官方GDP已降至比2009年水平低26%的水平。我们将实际的财政方案输入到希腊银行的DSGE模型中，该模型扩展后包含了非正规部门，以评估财政方案及其各项税收和支出措施的贡献。该模型解释了经济活动累计减少的大部分原因，并将约一半的下降归因于政府支出措施，另一半归因于税收增加。大规模财政调整与庞大且富有弹性的非正规部门之间的相互作用被证明是致命的。我们的模型预测，如果影子活动的增长受到遏制，财政调整、税收收入与宏观经济活动之间的恶性循环本可以得到显著缓解，从而使得经济衰退程度大为减轻。

articles.title_en: Dynamic CVaR portfolio construction with attention-powered generative factor learning
articles.title_cn: 基于注意力驱动的生成因子学习的动态CVaR投资组合构建
articles.abstract_en: The dynamic portfolio construction problem requires dynamic modeling of the joint distribution of multivariate stock returns. To achieve this, we propose a dynamic generative factor model which uses random variable transformation as an implicit way of distribution modeling and relies on the Attention-GRU network for dynamic learning and forecasting. The proposed model captures the dynamic dependence among multivariate stock returns, especially focusing on the tail-side properties. We also propose a two-step iterative algorithm to train the model and then predict the time-varying model parameters, including the time-invariant tail parameters. At each investment date, we can easily simulate new samples from the learned generative model, and we further perform CVaR portfolio optimization with the simulated samples to form a dynamic portfolio strategy. The numerical experiment on stock data shows that our model leads to wiser investments that promise higher reward-risk ratios and present lower tail risks.
articles.abstract_cn: 动态投资组合构建问题需要对多元股票收益的联合分布进行动态建模。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种动态生成因子模型，该模型使用随机变量变换作为分布建模的隐式方式，并依赖Attention-GRU网络进行动态学习和预测。所提出的模型捕捉多元股票收益之间的动态依赖性，尤其关注尾部特性。我们还提出了一种两步迭代算法来训练模型，然后预测时变模型参数，包括时不变的尾部参数。在每个投资日期，我们可以轻松地从学习到的生成模型中模拟新样本，并进一步利用模拟样本进行CVaR投资组合优化，以形成动态投资组合策略。对股票数据的数值实验表明，我们的模型能够带来更明智的投资，承诺更高的收益风险比，并呈现更低的尾部风险。

articles.title_en: Interbank Decisions and Margins of Stability: an Agent-Based Stock-Flow Consistent Approach
articles.title_cn: 银行间决策与稳定性边际：一种基于主体的存量-流量一致方法
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the functioning of modern payment systems through the lens of banks' maturity mismatch practices, and it examines the effects of banks' refusal to roll over short-term interbank liabilities on financial stability. Within an agent-based stock-flow consistent framework, banks can engage in two segments of the interbank market that differ in maturity, overnight and term. We compare two interbank matching scenarios to assess how bank-specific maturity targets, dependent on the dictates of the Net Stable Funding Ratio, impact the dynamics of the interbank market and the effectiveness of conventional monetary policies. The findings reveal that maturity misalignment between deficit and surplus banks compromises the interbank market's efficiency and increases reliance on the central bank's standing facilities. Monetary policy interest-rate steering practices also become less effective. The study also uncovers a dual stability-based configuration in the banking sector, resembling the segmented European interbank structure. This paper suggests that heterogeneous maturity mismatches between surplus and deficit banks may result in asymmetric funding frictions that might precede credit- and sovereign-risk explanations of interbank tensions. Also, a combined examination of macroprudential tools and rollover-based interbank dynamics can enhance our understanding of how regulatory changes impact the stability of heterogeneous banking sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过银行期限错配实践的视角探讨现代支付系统的运作，并考察银行拒绝展期短期银行间负债对金融稳定的影响。在基于主体的存量-流量一致框架内，银行可以参与银行间市场的两个期限不同的细分市场：隔夜和定期。我们比较了两种银行间匹配情景，以评估依赖于净稳定资金比率要求的银行特定期限目标如何影响银行间市场的动态以及常规货币政策的有效性。研究结果表明，赤字银行和盈余银行之间的期限错配损害了银行间市场的效率，并增加了对中央银行常备便利的依赖。货币政策的利率引导实践也变得不那么有效。研究还揭示了银行业中一种双重稳定性配置，类似于分割的欧洲银行间结构。本文提出，盈余银行和赤字银行之间的异质性期限错配可能导致不对称的融资摩擦，这些摩擦可能先于银行间紧张局势的信贷和主权风险解释。此外，对宏观审慎工具和基于展期的银行间动态的综合考察可以增强我们对监管变化如何影响异质性银行业部门稳定性的理解。

articles.title_en: On the role of automation in an epidemic
articles.title_cn: 论自动化在流行病中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines aggregate and distributional implications of automation in an epidemic. Using industry-level and firm-level data from the Chinese manufacturing sector, we document that the COVID-19 pandemic has led to a significant surge in the installation of industrial robots, and during the health crisis firms with more aggressive robot adoption experienced less severe revenue losses and a more pronounced increase in the wage gap between high-skilled and low-skilled workers. We then develop a tractable SIS-based macroeconomic model to explain these observations. The model economy has two steady states, and an outbreak can trigger a regime-switching transition from a disease-free steady state to an epidemic steady state. Accelerated robot adoption in the transition, stemming from labor shortfall and wage inflation, alleviates the loss in output but affects low-skilled labor disproportionately. These results are robust in an extended setting, where workers have an option to work remotely.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了流行病中自动化的总体和分配影响。利用中国制造业的行业层面和企业层面数据，我们记录了COVID-19疫情导致工业机器人安装量显著激增，并且在健康危机期间，机器人采用更为激进的企业收入损失较小，高技能与低技能工人之间的工资差距扩大更为明显。随后，我们开发了一个易于处理的基于SIS的宏观经济模型来解释这些观察结果。模型经济具有两个稳态，疫情爆发可以触发从无病稳态向流行病稳态的体制转换。在转换过程中，由于劳动力短缺和工资通胀，机器人采用加速，缓解了产出损失，但对低技能劳动力的影响不成比例。在工人可以选择远程工作的扩展设定中，这些结果依然稳健。
